product_metadata.title: Somdot Nightstand with 2 Drawers, Bedside Table Small Dresser with Removable Fabric Bins for Bedroom Nursery Closet Living Room - Sturdy Steel Frame, Wood Top, Pull Handle - Coffee Brown/Dark Walnut
features: 🏡 Multipurpose: Somdot 2 drawers nightstand is ideal for beds with a height of 16 inches to 24 inches. It fits in many locations throughout your home and also can be used as an end table in living room, as a toy storage in nursery, or placed inside the closet to create extra storage.

🏡 High Quality: Strong steel frame, durable wood board, adjustable plastic feet and premium fabric drawers all contribute to its sturdy construction to ensure durability against wear and tear over time.

🏡 Easy Assembly: Hardware is included for hassle-free assembly. Follow the instruction and you can put it together in a few steps. Drawer dimension 14.4 inches (W) x 10.8 inches (D) x 8.3 inches (H); Overall dimension 16.54 inches (W) x 11.81 inches (D) x 20.00 inches (H).

🏡 Stylish & Smart: Simple and modern style makes it fit to any decor. Lightweight design and 2 removable drawers are convenient for daily use. It works well in small areas while providing plenty of storage space, and mixes & matches with Somdot storage dressers or chest of drawers for a unique home style.
🏡 24/7 Service: Somdot professional support team are on standby. Please contact us with any issue at any time. We aim to bring you 100% satisfaction and provide 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee.
